title: OpenAI tests Sponsored Agents and expands AI tools for advertisers
friendlyTitle: ChatGPT ads can now open a conversation with a business
summary: OpenAI is testing clearly labelled Sponsored Agents that people can open from ChatGPT ads, while adding campaign creation and analysis through natural-language prompts. HubSpot and Shopify integrations bring the advertising system into tools businesses already use.
friendlySummary: OpenAI is testing sponsored business agents and simpler tools for making and managing ads. It is also connecting the system to HubSpot and Shopify.
whyItMatters: Advertising inside assistants is moving from a static link toward a conversation with the seller. People will need to distinguish sponsored guidance from independent answers, while small businesses gain a lower-friction route to create and manage campaigns.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Businesses may find it easier to run ads. People should notice when advice comes from a paid, sponsored agent.
